{"id":2015124236,"question_id":3405,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1779944487,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"87 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2015124236/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count the Number of Special Characters II","memory":"24.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int numberOfSpecialChars(string word) {\n        vector<int>lower(26 , -1);\n        vector<int>upper(26 , -1);\n\n        int n = word.size();\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(islower(word[i]))\n            {\n                lower[word[i] - 'a'] = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = n-1 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            if(isupper(word[i]))\n            {\n                upper[word[i] - 'A'] = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        int count = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<26 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(lower[i] != -1 && upper[i] != -1 && lower[i] < upper[i])\n            {\n                count++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-the-number-of-special-characters-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2037}
